MRT.note: The civil-status law ties issue of the national identification number to a nationality check, but no records passing between the registers are stated.

facts.fact: La Depeche reports that the fifth general population and housing census, organised in 2024, counted the country's population at nearly 5 million inhabitants.

La Depeche reports that the Assemblee nationale adopted a new civil-status law, adoption date not given and promulgation not stated, under which the national identification number is issued only once the applicant's Mauritanian nationality is verified.

MRT.note: Only the census population of nearly 5 million is given, with no enrolment count.
Births are declared within 60 days but the number is issued only after a nationality check, not at birth registration.
Only the issue conditions of the national identification number are described; no system status is stated.
Digitisation of civil-status procedures and correspondence is mentioned without saying births or deaths are entered digitally at local offices.
